decisions.reason: The Small Block prize already remains one $500 prize every 100 sales with Small Block ticket eligibility; eliminating Big Blocks does not change its current mechanism.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block eligibility, reset, and counter-independence attributes while retaining the operational removal fact.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block concepts from buyer earnings, prize descriptions, ticket rules, and revenue-split messaging.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 primary-mint allocation and identifies the Small Block prize pool as the sole active pool; prior secondary-sale funding rules are not rescinded.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the generic automatic prize-transfer, announcement, or notification workflow.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows the no-code ticket award from Small and Big Block tickets to a Small Block ticket.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete big_block_ticket_counter_visible attribute.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows each successful coded referral's prize-ticket award to one Small Block ticket.
The source decision changes Big Block mechanics and primary-mint allocation but does not modify the required flat $10 secondary-sale royalty.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder share, $5 referral commission, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and replacement of the obsolete generic prize-pool funding key.
The hero's generic reference to prize draw tickets remains accurate for the continuing Small Block prizes and does not necessarily require new copy.
The fiat on-ramp and provisioned wallet behavior remain valid; generic receipt of prizes does not depend on Big Block prizes remaining active.
